verdict.rationale: Cognee has no dedicated sandbox or staging feature. You can get a separate test environment by running it locally with Docker, which the docs say is "for development, testing" (cognee-docs-26), or by running the UI and pipelines on your own machine (cognee-docs-10). `cognee-cli demo` runs offline with no API key (cognee-docs-44), and per-dataset storage isolation can keep test data apart from production data on one instance (cognee-docs-9). Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox/test environment (e.g. a Cognee Cloud sandbox tier), guidance on keeping test and production data separate, a way to promote from test to production beyond `cognee-cli push` (cognee-docs-11), and hands-on corroboration.
